environment.description: Deployed on an EC2 instance (Amazon Linux 2) behind a Network Load Balancer (NLB, Layer 4 TCP passthrough). The NLB forwards raw TCP to port 8080. Security group allows inbound on port 443 from 0.0.0.0/0. No application-layer inspection. The Flask app runs via gunicorn with 4 workers. SQLite database at /var/data/inventory.db contains the api_keys table with production credentials.
